description: PreToolUse(Write|Edit) hygiene gate for the Claude Code auto-memory store. Blocks a write to `<...>/.claude/**/memory/*.md` — or to a store relocated by `autoMemoryDirectory` in any settings file it can read — whose content carries a known secret pattern (AWS/GitHub/GitLab/Slack/npm/Google/provider keys, PEM private-key headers), a control, bidirectional or zero-width character, or a body over the 2000-character cap. `MEMORY.md` is exempt from the size cap only — it is the index and grows by design. On Edit the payload carries a fragment, so the size cap is skipped there. Never blocks a non-memory path or another tool. Always exits 0 (allow) on parse errors (fail-open). Exits 2 to block. `--check-file <path|->` is the same policy as a direct CLI, for `harness-capture` to pre-check before proposing a write. Canonical registration lives in the plugin's top-level hooks.json; this file documents the bundle.
